text:
rachel: FYI starting onboarding for cust Umbrellus LoRA (umbrellus-lora-v1) layered onto redwood/aurora-13b. adapter introduces a tiny unicode-aware head (handles soft-hyphen and narrow NBSP) — quick micro-eval (500) kicked off.
tom: what's the acceptance criteria?
rachel: parity on extraction EM, rerank nDCG drop <=1.5 pts, token-boundary anomalies <=0.8%, and no currency formatting regressions. latency/cost targets same.
aditya: ran quick fp16 merge -> looks fine. int8 small perturbation. int4 merged artifact shows odd token-split behavior around soft-hyphen (\u00ad) and narrow no-break spaces (\u202f). also rerank ordering for short-answer QA degrades: baseline nDCG@5=0.88, umb-int4 nDCG@5=0.82 (delta -0.06). ll_mean delta -0.34 on our devset.
luke: samples from micro-500: ```
1) prompt 101: baseline -> "Model version: umb-1
2" | umb-int4 -> "Model version: umb-1 \u00ad2" (soft-hyphen inserted)
2) prompt 207: baseline -> "Total: ,250.00" | umb-int4 -> "Total: ,250 .00" (space before decimal)
3) rerank case R12: baseline ranking [docA, docC, docB] (score gap 0.12) | umb-int4 ranking [docC, docA, docB] (nDCG drop)
aggregate: unicode-token anomalies 7/500, rerank inversions 12/500
```
eval-bot: automated micro-eval: quality_regression=true, primary_metrics=["EM_drop","nDCG_delta"], values={"EM_drop":"3.1%","nDCG_delta":"-0.06","ll_delta":"-0.34"}. recommended_action=pin-customer-tokenizer + stitch-warmstart + quant-calib-with-cust-toks + collect-kv-alignment-diffs. run full evalpack (2k) before any canary.
aditya: cust tokenizer artifact = tok-2.0.1 (they added custom soft-hyphen handling). infra default = tok-2.1.0. re-ran local int4 merge with tok-2.0.1 pinned 1 and saw unicode anomalies drop to 3/500, nDCG delta improved to -0.03 but still present.
tom: interesting—so both tokenizer and quant amplify embedding shifts. propose: 1) stitch overlay (residual apply) for canary 2) export fp16 -> run quantize-aware calibration using cust tok-2.0.1 and extended rerank corpus 3) collect per-token entropy delta, KV alignment diffs for 1k prefixes, and rerank score distribution diffs.
rachel: agree. also add a metric to detect unicode-sequence tokenization changes (counts per character class) and a rerank-stability flag (fail canary if nDCG@5 delta < -0.04).
luke: queuing canary on dedicated aurora pool with stitch=true, tok_pin=tok-2.0.1, calib_samples=5000, rerank_corpus=10k, warm_cache=true. estimated ~3.5h. job id=umbrellus-canary-4612.
eval-bot: job queued 2026-07-08T08:15Z id=umbrellus-canary-4612. will post results and sample CSV when finished. :robot_face:
aditya: i'll also instrument layer-wise bin occupancy histograms to see whether punctuation/unicode tokens land on different int4 bins after the adapter. might reveal a small bias in the new head transform.
tom: if stitch+calib doesn't bring nDCG within threshold, prepare aurora-13b-int4-rerank-safe fallback and a routing rule to route rerank calls to the safe variant when rerank_stability=false.
rachel: please keep this thread updated. i'll request the customer's soft-hyphen testset and tokenizer debug artifact so we can add to our calibration corpora.
luke: starting canary now. will post back with CSV + 10 counterexamples and per-token diffs. :rocket:
